import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem pow_thirty_scalar_action_mod_seven (x : ℤ) : (5 : ℤ) ^ 30 * x ≡ x [ZMOD 7] := by
  have h₁ : (5 : ℤ) ^ 30 % 7 = 1 := by
    norm_num [pow_succ, pow_mul, Int.mul_emod, Int.pow_succ]
    <;> rfl
  
  have h₂ : (5 : ℤ) ^ 30 * x ≡ x [ZMOD 7] := by
    rw [Int.ModEq]
    
    simp [h₁, Int.mul_emod, Int.add_emod, Int.sub_emod]
    <;> ring_nf at *
    <;> omega
  
  exact h₂

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem pow_thirty_scalar_action_mod_seven (x : ℤ) : (5 : ℤ) ^ 30 * x ≡ x [ZMOD 7] := by
  have h₁ : (5 : ℤ) ^ 30 % 7 = 1 := by
    norm_num [pow_succ, Int.mul_emod, Int.emod_emod]
    <;> rfl
  
  have h₂ : (5 : ℤ) ^ 30 * x ≡ x [ZMOD 7] := by
    rw [Int.ModEq]
    have h₃ : ((5 : ℤ) ^ 30 * x) % 7 = x % 7 := by
      calc
        ((5 : ℤ) ^ 30 * x) % 7 = (((5 : ℤ) ^ 30 % 7) * (x % 7)) % 7 := by
          simp [Int.mul_emod, Int.pow_succ, Int.emod_emod]
        _ = (1 * (x % 7)) % 7 := by rw [h₁]
        _ = x % 7 := by simp [Int.mul_emod]
        _ = x % 7 := by rfl
    exact h₃
  exact h₂

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem pow_thirty_scalar_action_mod_seven (x : ℤ) : (5 : ℤ) ^ 30 * x ≡ x [ZMOD 7] := by
  have h₁ : (5 : ℤ) ^ 30 % 7 = 1 := by
    norm_num [Int.ModEq, Int.emod_eq_emod_iff_emod_sub_eq_zero]
    <;> rfl
  
  have h₂ : (5 : ℤ) ^ 30 * x ≡ x [ZMOD 7] := by
    rw [Int.ModEq]
    simp [h₁, Int.mul_emod, Int.emod_emod]
    <;> ring_nf at *
    <;> simp_all [Int.ModEq, Int.emod_eq_emod_iff_emod_sub_eq_zero]
    <;> norm_num
    <;> omega
  exact h₂

import Aesop

set_option autoImplicit false

theorem pow_thirty_scalar_action_mod_seven (x : ℤ) : (5 : ℤ) ^ 30 * x ≡ x [ZMOD 7] := by
  have h : (5 : ℤ) ^ 30 ≡ 1 [ZMOD 7] := by
    norm_num [Int.ModEq]
  simpa using h.mul_right x

import Mathlib
import Aesop

set_option autoImplicit false

theorem pow_thirty_scalar_action_mod_seven (x : ℤ) : (5 : ℤ) ^ 30 * x ≡ x [ZMOD 7] := by

    norm_num [Int.ModEq]
